labkit.ui.plot.fit

Fit axes limits to finite plotted X/Y data.

Syntax

limits = labkit.ui.plot.fit(ax) limits = labkit.ui.plot.fit(ax, graphicsHandles) limits = labkit.ui.plot.fit(ax, graphicsHandles, "Padding", 0.02)

Inputs

ax
target MATLAB axes or uiaxes handle.
graphicsHandles
optional graphics handles whose XData/YData should drive the fitted range. When omitted, finite X/Y data are collected from the axes children.
Padding
optional fractional padding, default 0.02.

Outputs

limits
struct with x and y fields containing the applied limits, or empty arrays when no finite data were available.

Example

h = plot(ax, t, y);
xline(ax, eventTime);
labkit.ui.plot.fit(ax, h);

Related APIs

  • labkit.ui.plot.clampData — Clamp data coordinates inside the visible axes box.
  • labkit.ui.plot.clear — Clear a plot axes before app-owned redraws.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fitCanvas — Fit one previewArea axes into a fixed pixel canvas frame.
  • labkit.ui.plot.message — Show a centered empty-state message in an axes.
  • labkit.ui.plot.offsetData — Offset data coordinates by normalized axes fractions.
